sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically supported: the required canonical cross-owner path or case-to-operand/result relationship is absent, while hasNaturalFrequencyCalculationCase has authoritative domain thrusterBody and cannot target a shipComponent or satisfy the required case structure.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the graph only records damping, added mass, attachment stiffness, and natural-frequency values, but does not encode that damping and water added mass are inputs taken into account and that ship attachment stiffness is modelled for each longitudinal and transverse estimation case. The calculation cases are only direction-labelled and are not linked to the declared operand terms or result; the comparisonModel obligation is therefore not faithfully represented.
